title: Sherpa-UI entity
description: One entity: a graph saved under a type, an id and a name. The envelope is the same for every type; the type's own schema (entity-<type>.v1.json) says what its settings hold. Its use inside another graph is a node whose kind is "<type>:<id>". checkEntity() reads it. docs/history/plan-746-entities-and-graph-views.md

type.description: A type the app has: the data layer's registry, and any the app registered.

graph.description: A workflow's nodes and routes. Inside, #in and #out are the entity's own sockets, as a Custom Node's.

settings.description: What the type keeps beside its graph; the type's own schema checks it.

uses.description: The entities its graph places, kept for a quick dependency check. The nodes are the truth.

origin.description: Set on read, never written: a preset is a file's and read only; the reader's own are mine.
